World of Hyatt points

World of Hyatt points book stays at Park Hyatt, Andaz, Grand Hyatt and other Hyatt hotels. On the AirMilesHK Marketplace, members list the World of Hyatt points they have, and buyers make offers or request a hotel stay. When a deal is agreed, AirMilesHK holds the payment until the seller delivers.

How it works

Trading World of Hyatt points, safely

  1. Browse or listAnyone can browse World of Hyatt listings. Joining is free and needed to make an offer or list your own points.
  2. Make an offerBid on part of a balance, the whole account where offered, or ask the seller to book a hotel stay for you.
  3. Agree the termsThe seller accepts, counters or declines. Counter as often as you need.
  4. AirMilesHK in the middleThe buyer pays AirMilesHK, the seller delivers, and we release the payment once both sides confirm.
Most loyalty programmes, including World of Hyatt, do not allow selling or transferring points or accounts. Please read the marketplace rules before you trade. Prefer a simple purchase? See AirMilesHK's own World of Hyatt page.
